product: Logitech G headsets (HID++ 2.0, and the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED over Centurion)
works: written from Solaar (e7304c4c) and HeadsetControl (91ee690a) and checked against simulated headsets only (tests/sim-logitech-headset.mjs)
feature lookup through Root getFeature (no fixed indexes), on the dongle and, for the PRO X 2, through its Centurion bridge
battery: 0x1004 / 0x1000, else 0x1F20 (millivolts, Solaar's voltage curve, charging flag); PRO X 2: 0x0104 percent and charging
sidetone: 0x8300 read fn 0x00 / write fn 0x10, 0-100 (Solaar Sidetone); PRO X 2: 0x0604 read 0x00 / write 0x10 in the headset's own gain steps (Solaar HeadsetSidetone)

turn off when idle: 0x1F20 v2+ read 0x10 / write 0x20, 0-255 min (Solaar ADCPower), the G535 limited to HeadsetControl's 0 / 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30; PRO X 2: 0x0108 read 0x00 / write 0x10, the other timer slots sent back as read (Solaar HeadsetAutoSleep)
mic muted, shown only: 0x0601 read fn 0x10 (Solaar HeadsetMicMute)
EQ per band where the headset has 0x8310: range and band frequencies from the headset, read fn 0x20 [00], write fn 0x30 [02, gains] with every other band sent back as read (Solaar Equalizer)
every write read back; every write refused while G HUB (lghub*.exe) runs
doesNotWork: firmware updates, DFU, resets and pairing (never: Logitech's own app only)
setting the mic mute (only shown; the headset's own button mutes)
EQ on the PRO X 2 (0x020D / 0x0636: no plain read of the same value documented)
G432 / G431 / G433 and G533 sidetone (HeadsetControl writes it with fixed bytes and no read)
G522 (Centurion with a device address Solaar has to probe), G435 and ASTRO A50 X (in neither project), ASTRO A50 Gen 4 / 5 (their own protocol)
